# Routes a mode that federates adds to those of its mode (testdata/routes-local.txt, and
# testdata/routes-single.txt in single mode with FLOWA_FEDERATE=on): discovery, docs/federation.md 5.3 and
# 5.4; the actors, the public pages and their pictures, 5.5, 5.6, 6.5 and 9.4; a post's Create, the
# outboxes and the collections, 6.2 and 6.4; the search by handle a member makes, 5.3 and 11; the
# federation page of the admin area with the domain policies, section 10 and FMD 1; the inboxes, section 7
# and FWR 1; a remote account's profile, following it, blocking it and the follow requests, 6.4 and 11, FWR 3;
# "Remove me from other servers", 11 and FWR 7.
# TestDBFederatedRoutes holds the table to it.
DELETE /api/admin/federation/domains/{domain}
DELETE /api/fed/accounts/{id}/block
DELETE /api/fed/accounts/{id}/follow
DELETE /api/fed/requests/{id}
GET /.well-known/nodeinfo
GET /.well-known/webfinger
GET /actor
GET /actor/outbox
GET /api/admin/federation
GET /api/fed/accounts/{id}
GET /api/fed/media/{file}
GET /api/fed/requests
GET /nodeinfo/2.1
GET /users/{name}
GET /users/{name}/avatar.jpg
GET /users/{name}/avatar.png
GET /users/{name}/featured
GET /users/{name}/followers
GET /users/{name}/following
GET /users/{name}/outbox
GET /users/{name}/posts/{id}
GET /users/{name}/posts/{id}/activity
GET /users/{name}/posts/{id}/picture.jpg
GET /users/{name}/posts/{id}/picture.png
POST /actor/inbox
POST /api/fed/lookup
POST /api/me/federation/leave
POST /inbox
POST /users/{name}/inbox
PUT /api/admin/federation/domains/{domain}
PUT /api/admin/federation/policy
PUT /api/fed/accounts/{id}/block
PUT /api/fed/accounts/{id}/follow
